summary: Full end-to-end validation of Watchful (Fase 1+2). Backend: 16/16 pytest passing including real Gemini Nano Banana free (sky) and paid (twilight) edits, insufficient credits (HTTP 402 in Spanish), file serving with query token, property/user scoping, batch job async completion. Frontend: landing page renders with Spanish hero + before/after slider; register flow lands on /app with credit counter=30; create property, upload photo, open editor showing 9 actions (3 GRATIS, 6 PREMIUM with correct costs 2/2/1/2/3/1), apply free 'Reemplazo de cielo' via confirm modal (shows 'Gratis'), before-after slider appears after AI call, success toast displayed.

issues: After upload, photo card is very small (~200px) and dark; original image thumbnail label 'Original' is barely visible against black. Consider larger tile or contrast improvement.

Before/after image area appears mostly black at 1440x900 in the test (image content not rendered) — likely a rendering nuance with the 1x1 test PNG; unlikely to affect real photos, worth spot-check with a real image.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: auth resolver prefers cookies over Authorization Bearer, which can cause cross-user confusion if a client accidentally sends both. Consider prioritizing Authorization header when present, or clearing cookie on register/login of a different user. This tripped tests until switched to bare requests; users switching accounts in the same browser tab should be fine due to overwrite.

server.py:_apply_edit — 'disclosure' logic contains redundant/confusing expression: `new_disclosure = photo.get('disclosure') or (disc and action['disclosure_default'] is not None and disc)`; the variable `new_disclosure` is computed but never used (the $set uses a different expression). Dead code — remove or wire it.
server.py has 500+ lines; consider splitting routes into modules (auth/properties/photos/edit/files).
storage.put_object retries only on 404; consider also retrying 401/403 and adding exponential backoff for transient upstream errors.
test_credentials: Admin admin@watchful.app / Watchful2026! (seeded). Test users are created dynamically via /api/auth/register with prefix test_user_ / test_ui_.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral users and properties prefixed 'TEST_'/'test_ui_' — not cleaned up automatically. Backend seeds admin@watchful.app on startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL is env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Tests use bare `requests` (not Session) because backend auth resolver prefers cookies over Authorization Bearer — a shared Session leaks auth across users. Free (sky) and paid (twilight) Gemini calls both succeeded in ~15-30s. Batch endpoint returns 402 when total_cost > credits. 'test_insufficient_credits' uploads 20 tiny PNGs and requests a staging batch (60 credits needed > 30) to reliably trigger 402 without incurring real AI cost.
